text: The Fourth Disaster Risk Management Development Policy Loan with a Catastrophe-Deferred Drawdown Option (CAT-DDO 4) is a $500 million contingent credit line from the World Bank, designed to strengthen the Philippines' capacity to manage climate, disaster, and health-related risks. It provides rapid access to liquidity following a national State of Calamity or Public Health Emergency declaration, supporting policy and institutional reforms for disaster risk management and public health emergency readiness.
